worldcombat.skill.spark.summary: Quickly strike a target, possibly paralyzing it. Deals more damage to targets with low health.
worldcombat.skill.spark.description.0: A charged tackle that settles about %1$s contact damage on a single target; it closes up to %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick with a %4$s block hit radius.
worldcombat.skill.spark.description.1: On a hit there is a %1$s%% chance to paralyze the target for %2$s (an already-paralyzed target is not re-applied; Electric types are immune) and shove it %3$s blocks; while paralyzed the target's movement speed is halved and each action has a 25%% chance to fail.
worldcombat.skill.spark.overcharge.on: Overcharge: higher power and paralyze chance and a longer paralysis, but a slower windup and a longer cooldown - pin the target down once.
worldcombat.skill.spark.overcharge.off: Tap shot: faster windup and cycle and a slightly longer reach, but lower power and paralyze chance - wear the target down with frequency.
worldcombat.skill.spark.timing: Range %1$s blocks; windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.spark.growth.0: From level %1$s the electric power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.spark.growth.1: From level %1$s the electric power rises to %2$s and the paralyze chance to %3$s%%.
worldcombat.skill.spark.use.0: Close in and paralyze a target that is not paralyzed yet
worldcombat.skill.spark.use.1: Finish off a badly hurt target with the shortest move of the family
worldcombat.skill.spark.use.2: Harass at high frequency in a scuffle and force the target to move
worldcombat.skill.spark.preference.overc: On: higher power and paralyze chance and a longer paralysis, but a slower windup and a longer cooldown - pin the target down once. Off (Tap shot): faster windup and cycle and a slightly longer reach, but lower power and paralyze chance.
worldcombat.skill.spark.preference.ai.ma: It only dives in within this distance; it closes in first. Spark's reach is short, so a large value rarely helps.
worldcombat.skill.spark.preference.ai.fi: On: targets below 35% health come first, where the finishing bonus applies; off: plain melee ordering.
